candidate.blueprint_locator: 2026 NCLEX-RN Test Plan, Pharmacological and Parenteral Therapies, printed p.12 / PDF p.16
candidate.educational_objective: Identify the labeled 5-day oral azithromycin regimen for adult mild community-acquired pneumonia.

options.A: 500 mg on day 1, then 250 mg once daily on days 2 through 5
options.D: 250 mg on day 1, then increase the dose each day

candidate.rationale: Current DailyMed labeling lists 500 mg as a single dose on day 1 followed by 250 mg once daily on days 2 through 5 for adult mild community-acquired pneumonia.
candidate.source_claim_supported: For adult mild community-acquired pneumonia, the labeled regimen is 500 mg day 1 then 250 mg daily days 2–5.
candidate.source_locator: Dosage and Administration, Section 2.1 > Adult Patients > Community-acquired pneumonia (mild severity)
candidate.stem: An adult is prescribed oral azithromycin for mild community-acquired pneumonia using the labeled 5-day regimen. Which schedule matches the prescribing information?
